title_en: Beautiful Places in China (7/20): West Lake, Boats Beneath the Willows
note_en: 各有各的 + noun means "each has its own...": 无论是雨中的西湖还是雪后的西湖，都各有各的美 "Whether it's West Lake in the rain or after snow, each has its own beauty." Repeating 各 stresses that every item has something different. English says "each has its own" once, while Chinese doubles the 各 and usually adds 都 before it, as again in Xiao Zhou's last thought: 无论是船上的西湖还是岸边的西湖，都各有各的美.
